rubric: 2-trial coupling proof per docs/architecture-briefs/2026-05-22-refactor/p2-e-regression-scenario-spec.md (TA cycle-17 / macro cycle-57 precedent)

baseline.note: 2 primitive canary scenarios + 1 module canary scenario added as permanent coverage

canary_scenarios_added.role: Trial-1 regression canary — whitespace-only URL must fall through to headline key
canary_scenarios_added.coupling: Shares guard pattern (.trim() === '' empty check) with published-at-parser

canary_scenarios_added.role: Trial-2 primary scenario — internal hyphen must not be stripped
canary_scenarios_added.coupling: Trial-2 primary; combined with module canary proves coupling through multi-word attribution

canary_scenarios_added.role: Trial-2 regression canary — two articles with multi-word attribution must dedup to articleCount=1
canary_scenarios_added.coupling: Exercises headline-normalizer + source-dedup-key pipeline; breaks when normalizeHeadline uses single-word-only strip pattern

trial_1.bug_injected: double-UTC-offset: extract offset from rfcDate string and re-subtract it from Date() output (Date() already normalised it)
trial_1.primary_red: published-at-parser edge scenario FAIL (15/16 sandbox, exit 1)
trial_1.naive_fix_applied: Fixed published-at-parser correctly; but ALSO changed source-dedup-key URL guard from 'url !== null && url.trim() !== ""' to 'url !== null && url !== ""' — removing .trim() check
trial_1.naive_fix_effect_on_canary: Whitespace-only URL '   ' no longer caught by guard → falls through to url branch → key becomes 'url:   ' instead of 'headline:reuters:...'
trial_1.correct_fix: Single edit: revert source-dedup-key URL guard to 'url !== null && url.trim() !== ""'
trial_1.outcome: outcome-(a) OBSERVED — coupled source-dedup-key card RED mid-fix, single-edit correct fix restores all-green

trial_2.bug_injected: greedy attribution strip pattern: changed /\s+[-–]\s+\w[\w\s.]*$/ to /\s*[-–].*$/ — matches at FIRST hyphen including internal hyphens
trial_2.bug_effect: 'Vietnam-US trade agreement signed - Reuters' → 'Vietnam' (strips from first hyphen)
trial_2.primary_red: headline-normalizer/canary-attribution-hyphen.json FAIL: expected 'Vietnam-US trade agreement signed' | got 'Vietnam'
trial_2.canary_at_injection: news_ingest/canary-dedup-normalization GREEN (multi-word attributions still stripped by greedy pattern)
trial_2.naive_fix_applied: Changed regex to / - \w+$/ (single-word only) — fixes canary-attribution-hyphen but fails to strip multi-word attributions like ' - The Financial Times', ' - Nikkei Asia Review'
trial_2.naive_fix_effect_on_canary: Two articles with different multi-word attributions normalize to different strings → different dedup keys → NO dedup → articleCount=2 instead of 1

coupled_red_state.diff: expected {articleCount:1} | got {articleCount:2} (two different normalized strings, no dedup)
coupled_red_state.dashboard: PASS:4 FAIL:2 verdict=FAIL (news_ingest module card RED)

trial_2.correct_fix: Single edit: restore original regex /\s+[-–]\s+\w[\w\s.]*$/ which strips both single and multi-word attributions
trial_2.outcome: outcome-(a) OBSERVED — coupled news_ingest module card RED mid-fix, single-edit correct fix restores all-green
